prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='ARIMA', seasonality_champion='catboost', recommended_method='stl_hierarchical_stacking'. Narrative: ARIMA and catboost tie for trend correlation (0.0), with ARIMA selected as trend champion; catboost leads seasonality correlation at 0.4648. CWT_rf achieves the lowest RMSE (361.01) as overall champion. High disagreement (RMSE spread ratio 5.89) and seasonality variance (0.76) combined with different trend/seasonality champions strongly suggest STL-hierarchical stacking to exploit decomposition-aware combination while handling model heterogeneity.
